summary: Loves character-driven American drama that hooks from episode 1: crime and family sagas (Breaking Bad, The Wire, The Sopranos, Ozark, Yellowstone, The Departed), heart-forward sports and ensemble stories (Friday Night Lights, Shawshank, Ted Lasso, Moneyball, Spotlight), and warm or sharp comedy (Shrinking, The Office, Fleabag). Loved Severance. Bounces off slow-burn starts and cold, ironic tone (quit Succession and Slow Horses early; didn't like No Country for Old Men or The Social Network). Prefers emotional payoff over bleak ambiguity.
